messages:
alex: Heads up — Acme Security just sent a SIG review with a heavy focus on access control. They want:
- SAML metadata + IdP config screenshots
- Proof MFA is enforced (policy + screenshots)
- RBAC role matrix and least-privilege justification
- Example service account scopes and session durations

Can someone own compiling a packet we can hand to their vendor team by EOD Friday? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: I can pull SAML metadata and the IdP screenshots (Okta). Will also export our SAML SP metadata XML. Need to know which environment (prod/stage) they want — usually prod for controls checks.

jordan: I’ll take RBAC role matrix and least-privilege notes. I have the CSV from last month with role -> perms mapping, can redact internal-only roles.

samir: I can grab the MFA policy screenshots and the enforcement logs for the last 30 days. Do they want evidence for both interactive and API tokens?

alex: Good q — email says "MFA enforcement across console and API". So yes both. Also they asked for session timeout settings and any conditional access rules.

maria: OK will capture: Okta policy page + example login flow, and a screenshot of policy that requires MFA for unknown devices. Will include the SAML Assertion attribute map snippet.

jordan: For role matrix I’ll include:
- role name, description, allowed API surface, least-privilege rationale
- example RBAC policy snippets (Terraform) for role bindings

Sample snippet I’ll include:
```
resource "redwood_iam_role" "reader" {
  name        = "project_reader"
  permissions = ["read:models","read:logs"]
}
```

samir: For API tokens: we rotate keys and require MFA for console SSO. For service principals we have scoped service accounts with 1-yr expiry and short-lived tokens via STS (aws-style). Will attach logs showing token issuance and a short doc on our JIT elevation process.

security-bot: Incident reminder: No sensitive creds in uploads. Use sanitized screenshots and redact GUIDs/team names.

alex: Thanks — timeline: pack by Friday EOD. Maria/Jordan/Samir to upload artifacts to the shared drive and paste link here. Also need a short cover note that explains how these controls satisfy SIG questions 3.2/3.3/3.4.

maria: Link uploaded: https://drive.company/acme-sig-poc/ (redacted link). Uploaded: saml_metadata.xml, okta-policy-01.png, okta-attr-map.txt

jordan: Uploaded role-matrix.csv and rbac-snippets.md. I redacted internal admin role entries and added comments for least-privilege.

samir: Uploaded mfa-screenshots.zip and token-audit-30d.csv. Note: token-audit contains aliases and issuance timestamps only (sanitized).

alex: Perfect. Can someone paste a 2–3 sentence cover summary I can send to the prospect? Keep it non-technical enough for vendor risk.

jordan: "Redwood enforces SSO via SAML with IdP-managed MFA and conditional access. Access is governed by role-based controls that map narrowly to service capabilities; tokens are short-lived and service accounts are scoped for least privilege. Audit logs and policy screenshots are included for verification." 

maria: Minor edits to include session timeout: "Sessions and API tokens follow conservative timeout and rotation policies; conditional access enforces MFA for unknown contexts. Documentation and screenshots attached."

alex: Nice. I’ll add pricing note for POC: recommend offering 2-week Dedicated trial (discounted) so they can validate RBAC/SAML flows internally. Need approval from pricing — looping in @samir for any blockers w/ enterprise terms.

samir: Pricing OK from my side for a trial, but legal needs to sign the DPA addendum for SSO integrations. I’ll confirm with legal today.

alex: Great. If legal flags anything, we’ll pause the POC. Otherwise I’ll send the packet + cover note to Acme security and schedule a 30-min walkthrough next week. :calendar:

maria: One more: Acme asked for an attribute map example. Here’s the SAML attr snippet I included:
```
<Attribute Name="email">urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.3</Attribute>
<Attribute Name="groups">urn:mace:dir:attribute-def:eduPersonEntitlement</Attribute>
```

alex: Thanks all — thread closed once legal confirms. Will update here. :white_check_mark:
